tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ye shes mgon po'i gsang khrid nag po khros pa'i rgyud las padmas bsdus pa bzhugs so:

bka' rgya yod do: khrag 'thung dpal gyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang thob dam ldan rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: dur khrod dam ni rang gi sgrub khang du: sku gsung thugs rten phyi nang mchod gtor bsham: dad brtson shes rab snying rje'i sems bskyed la: dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag rgyud la brten: 'khor ba'i bya bar snying po yod med blta: las 'bras bslu med phra zhib rgyu 'bras sems: dkon mchog bla mar skyabs 'gro tshad med bsgom: spyi bor kun bzang che mchog thod phreng rtsal: yang yang gsol btab ci yod mchod par 'bul: thal sbyar pus btsugs snying nas gus pa yi: gdung ba'i shugs kyis nga ro dbyangs snyan pas: mchi ma ma byung bar du gsol ba btab: hūm̐ hūm̐: sku gsum bla ma che mchog thod phreng rtsal: 'khor 'das kun gyi dngos grub stsol ba'i dpal: nag po chen po sku gsum he ru ka: gsol ba 'debs so dbang bzhi bskur du gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag dur khrod 'bar ba'i dbus: rang byung ye shes me rlung 'khrugs pa'i 'od: 'khor 'das dbang sdud nag po'i 'khor tshogs can: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: rang lus 'od gsal sgyu lus dag pa'i zhing: gzung 'dzin dag pa snying po dbu ma'i nang: srog bzhi 'dus pa ma hūm̐ dwangs ma'i 'od: rlung sems dbyer med don dam bde ba'i sku: rang byung ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma hā gu ru ma hā kā la sarba siddhi hūm̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gzhung ltar dbang bzhi len nam gnas bzhi'i bcud: bdud rtsir drangs la spyi bo'i gtsug nas bstim: snying gar bla ma che mchog yab yum dang: ma hūm̐ dbyer med gcig tu bsres la bsgom: rlung ro gsum gyis khams gsum bar chad gtor: rngub rlung gsum gyis lte 'og gtum mo sbar: snying gar yab yum sbyor mtshams rlung yig g.yos: dbu mar me sbar 'od lngas snying ga yi: bla ma thugs srog ma hūm̐ snyoms par zhugs:

spyi bo'i haṃ bskyod bdud rtsi dbab skyil bsrung: de las skyes pa'i rang byung lta ba bskyang: mig ni bar snang stong pa'i ngang la blta: dur khrod khrag 'thung rig pa'i he ru ka: ma bskyed dbyings na gsal bar bzhugs pa mthong: 'du ba med cing 'bral ba gnas pa med: rang gi sems nyid stong gsal 'od lnga'i rtsal: skye ba'i yul med 'chi med rtogs bya'i phyir: yid mig rlung gsum gnad gcig ltems nas kyang: dbang gi ye shes bdun nam nyer gcig bsgom: mthong bas 'du dang 'bral ba zhes bya'i ming: de dang bral bas gsal 'grib med pa'i thugs: yang dag don gyi mgon por lhun gyis grub: de tshe rang gi ye shes dgyes ma dgyes: sgrub pa'i rdzas dang bzlas pa'i sngags kyang med: thams cad rang gis byas pa yin par rtogs: snang srid me long gzugs brnyan ltar shes 'gyur: rang gis rang lus snang stong lha skur rtogs: brag cha lta bur gsang ba'i sngags rnams thob: rang gis rang 'dul lha tshogs sems su rdzogs: sems kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i byang chub sems: rig pa'i don nyid rtogs pas thams cad 'dul: phyi nang zhi khro'i bskyed rim gsal dag nas: rang gis rang 'dul don dam rig pa'i lha: byin rlabs mgon po yab yum 'od gsal sku: zhal gcig chos sku phyag bzhi phrin las bzhi: zhabs gnyis snang stong yab yum zung du 'jug: 'khor ba rnam dag myang 'das lhun gyis rdzogs: 'gyur med don dam mthing nag rdo rje sems: don gyi mgon po nag po chen po ni: dregs pa 'dul byed lha sku'i mchog yin no: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥzhes bzlas pa yis: khrag 'thung rigs lnga ye shes chen po'i sku: dug lnga ma spang mgon por lhun gyis grub: dregs pa 'dul zhing sku gsum lhun gyis grub: lta sgom spyod pa dam tshig dang ldan pas: dbang bzhi'i 'bras bu rgyud la ster bar byed: rjes su dur khrod rgyu zhing brtul zhugs spyad:

bsngo ba smon lam gdab cing bskyed rdzogs 'od gsal gzung: nyal dus thugs srog dbus su thig ler bsdu: lang dus khro rgyal nga rgyal bskyed cing lang: khrus dang kha zas bdud rtsi lnga yis bya: thun gcig lha bsgom thun gcig 'phrul 'khor bskor: thun gcig rlung dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya: thun gcig tshogs dang gtor ma kha zas rol: nyin gung mtshan gung ngal gso lta ba bskyang: rjes spyod dal spang gegs sel bogs 'don bya: de ltar bsgrubs pas 'bras bu skye 'chi dang: bar dor grol nas sku gsum thob par 'gyur: sku gsung thugs khros gsang ba'i rgyud chen dang: rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs bzhin bcud du gdams: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: padma bdag gis yi ger bris nas bskyed rdzogs kyi yang them du bzhag pa'o: kha thaṃ:
